annotations.title: Target or exclude audiences on Google Ads

description: Who a Google Ads campaign reaches. adGroupId (Search/Display): userLists, interests (affinity/in-market ids), customSegments (Display only), mode "observation" (report, do not narrow — default on Search) or "targeting" (narrow to them); Demand Gen ad groups take audiences[] ids. assetGroupId (Performance Max): audiences[] as signals and searchThemes[]. campaignId: exclusions only. exclude{userLists, interests, customSegments}, excludeAges ["18-24"…"65+","unknown"], excludeGenders, excludeIncomes (household income bands; with campaignId this is how a Performance Max campaign excludes them). remove[] takes criterion resource names from a call with no changes (which lists what is set). Narrowing a LIVE ad group needs confirm:true.

adGroupId.description: ad group to target (Search, Display or Demand Gen); one of adGroupId, assetGroupId, campaignId

assetGroupId.description: Performance Max asset group id; audiences become signals there

audiences.description: audience ids from manage_google_ads_audience (create_audience) for Demand Gen or Performance Max

confirm.description: true to approve a change that alters who a live ad group reaches

customSegments.description: custom segment ids to target; Display ad groups only, Search refuses them

customerId.description: Google Ads account id, 10 digits (dashes ok); omit for the brand's default account

dryRun.description: true = validate with Google and change nothing

exclude.description: audiences to exclude from the ad group or campaign: {userLists, interests, customSegments} ids

excludeAges.description: age ranges to exclude: 18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55-64, 65+ or unknown

excludeGenders.description: genders to exclude: male, female or unknown

excludeIncomes.description: household income bands to exclude: top10 (the highest-income 10% of households), 11-20, 21-30, 31-40, 41-50, lower50 (the lower half) or unknown

interests.description: interest ids (affinity or in-market) to target on the ad group

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id, when the account is managed through one

mode.description: observation (report only, default on Search) or targeting (narrow delivery to these audiences)

remove.description: criterion resource names to remove; a call with no other changes lists the current ones

searchThemes.description: search theme phrases for a Performance Max asset group, up to 50, 10 words or fewer each

userLists.description: user list ids to target on the ad group

name: set_google_ads_audiences
title: Target or exclude audiences on Google Ads
